description: US macro dashboard from BLS in one call: CPI and core CPI, unemployment, nonfarm payrolls, hourly earnings, participation, PPI and JOLTS openings. Latest value, month, MoM / YoY change and 13-month history. Includes BLS retrieval date and disclaimer. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/us-macro

indicators.description: comma-separated subset (default all): cpi, core_cpi, unemployment_rate, nonfarm_payrolls, avg_hourly_earnings, labor_force_participation, ppi_final_demand, jolts_openings
